full_writer_schema.record_assignment_source:
record = {
                                "event": "SLLM_LOAD_EVIDENCE", "pid": os.getpid(),
                                "tp_rank": get_tp_group().rank_in_group, "device": str(self.device),
                                "device_uuid": device_uuid,
                                "phase": "load_boundary_before_profiler_exit_reset",
                                "load_completed": load_error is None,
                                "load_error_type": None if load_error is None else type(load_error).__name__,
                                "registered_model_available": model is not None,
                                "memory": memory, "quant_method_counts": dict(quant_methods) if model is not None else None,
                                "kernel_backend_counts": dict(kernel_backends) if model is not None else None,
                                "registered_tensors": registered if model is not None else None,
                                "registered_storages": list(storages.values()) if model is not None else None,
                                "unique_registered_storage_bytes": sum(x["bytes"] for x in storages.values()) if model is not None else None,
                                "empty_g_idx_keys": [x["name"] for x in registered
                                                     if "g_idx" in x["name"] and x["bytes"] == 0] if model is not None else None,
                                "capture_seconds": time.perf_counter() - capture_started,
                                "synchronized": True,
                                "coverage": "registered parameter/buffer storage only; nonregistered workspace, native allocations and driver peak are not covered",
                            }
full_writer_schema.file_naming: rank-%d-pid-%d.json inside SLLM_LOAD_EVIDENCE_DIR=/evidence/load-evidence, host worker/load-evidence. serialized=json.dumps(record) immediately after dictionary; no later clock/endpoint keys added beforefilewrite.
full_writer_schema.model_loader_internal_float_timer: time_before_load perf_counter at4750 and time_after_load4810 are only consumed by local logger at4965-4967; not serialized as absolute endpoints or rank clock metadata.
full_writer_schema.capture_seconds: Time since capture_started at4821, including synchronize/metadata work; not load duration.

conclusion: No usable complete8rank max(end)-min(begin) in reviewed public metadata/expected pinned f7 schema. This is not a global claim that every private historical log/file lacks other instrumentation; private originals below were not readable.
mapping_scope: Own32 fixed primaryattempts/256rank identities. Related lifecycle instance/backend clock kept separate from nonexistent self-recorded rank endpointclock. Do not substitute owner startticks, capture_seconds, f7 singlelogger, backendinit or filemtime.
